parameters.jsCode: const raw=String($json.data||$json.body||$json||''); const items=[]; const re=/<item>([\s\S]*?)<\/item>/gi; let m; while((m=re.exec(raw))&&items.length<30){const block=m[1]; const get=tag=>{const x=new RegExp('<'+tag+'[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/'+tag+'>','i').exec(block); return x?x[1].replace(/<!\[CDATA\[|\]\]>/g,'').trim():''}; items.push({title:get('title'),link:get('link'),pubDate:get('pubDate'),description:get('description')});} return [{json:{newsItems:items}}];

parameters.jsCode: const job=$node['Normalize Research Job'].json; const response=$json; let raw=response?.choices?.[0]?.message?.content??response?.output??response?.text??response; if(typeof raw!=='string')raw=JSON.stringify(raw); raw=raw.trim().replace(/^```json/i,'').replace(/^```/i,'').replace(/```$/i,'').trim(); let result; try{result=JSON.parse(raw)}catch(e){throw new Error('LLM did not return valid JSON: '+e.message)} const opportunities=Array.isArray(result.opportunities)?result.opportunities.slice(0,job.maxOpportunities):[]; for(const op of opportunities){if(!op.companyName||!op.productName)continue; if(!Array.isArray(op.evidence))op.evidence=[]; op.buyingSignals=Array.isArray(op.buyingSignals)?op.buyingSignals:[]; op.status='New';} return [{json:{jobId:job.jobId,callbackUrl:job.callbackUrl,callbackSecret:job.callbackSecret,provider:'N8N',status:result.status==='FAILED'?'FAILED':'COMPLETED',notes:String(result.notes||'').slice(0,2500),opportunities}}];
